subject: Piece of Heart
text: Catching a fish weighing 10 pounds or more at the fishing pond for 20 rupees awards a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
swim to the fishing pond.  Go in and pay 20 rupees to fish to get [PoH16]  
you'll have to catch a 10 pound or bigger fish

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is found at night on the island with two pillars.

evidence.quote:
swim across the 
lake to the island with two pillars on it.  Once there make it night time  
if it isn't already and collect [GS026]

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Releasing bugs onto the mound of soil at the Lakeside Laboratory reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
follow  
the two bridges to the Laboratory where you'll find a mound of soil, use  
your bugs to collect [GS027]

subject: Magic Bean
text: A magic bean can be planted in the soft soil patch near the Lakeside Laboratory.

evidence.quote:
Laboratory where you'll find a mound of soil, use  
your bugs to collect [GS027], and plant a magic bean there.

subject: King Zora
text: Delivering Ruto's letter to King Zora causes him to move aside and grant access to Lord Jabu Jabu.

evidence.quote:
Take the letter to King Zora and  
he'll let you behind him to where Lord Jabu Jabu is.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Rolling into the lone tree immediately to the right upon entering Zora's Fountain reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
to the immediate right from entering and roll into the lone tree  
exposing [GS028].

subject: Farore's Wind
text: Bombing the wall touching the silver rock in Zora's Fountain grants Farore's Wind.

evidence.quote:
Bomb the wall touching the silver rock and get Farore's  
Wind before heading back to Jabu Jabu.

subject: Lord Jabu-Jabu
text: Releasing a fish in front of Lord Jabu Jabu causes him to inhale Link into his belly.

evidence.quote:
Empty your fish in front of him and 
he'll suck you and the fish into his belly.

subject: Biri
text: Before acquiring the boomerang, electrified jellyfish can be defeated with Deku Sticks or by throwing Princess Ruto at them.

evidence.quote:
until you get the boomerang use Deku sticks on the  
electrified jellyfish or throw Princess Ruto at them.

subject: Big Octo
text: Stunning the giant octorock with the boomerang allows Link to kill him with one jump attack using a Deku Stick.

evidence.quote:
When you fight the  
giant octorock stun him with the boomerang and if he's not facing you, you  
can run around the platform, either way one jump attack with a Deku stick  
kills him.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is located at night on the wall across from the log near Lord Jabu Jabu.

evidence.quote:
You're back outside if it's day time make it night and you'll see [GS033]   
on the wall across from the log you started the screen standing on

subject: House of Skulltula
text: The Giant's Wallet is awarded at the House of Skulltula in Kakariko Village.

evidence.quote:
Go to the house of Skullita  
and get your Giant's wallet.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula appears at night on the wall in the far right corner of the Graveyard.

evidence.quote:
run into the graveyard and make it night  
time, in the far right corner there's [GS034] on the wall.

subject: Magic Bean
text: Magic beans can be planted in the soft soil patch in the Graveyard.

evidence.quote:
On the way out  
plant the magic beans in the soil.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: In the windmill, throwing the boomerang at the top part of the Piece of Heart while the moving platform carries Link away on the left side retrieves it.

evidence.quote:
head into the windmill and look up  
at [PoH17] when the moving platform puts you on the left side moving away  
from the piece of heart, throw the boomerang up at the top part of the 
heart and it'll be pulled down to you

subject: Running Man
text: Selling the Bunny Hood to the Running Man in Hyrule Field completely maxes out Link's rupees.

evidence.quote:
sell the running man the bunny hood (he maxes out your 
rupees, so if you sold it to him when you had the adult's wallet you missed 
out on 300 rupees).

subject: Happy Mask Shop
text: The Mask of Truth can be obtained from the mask shop near Hyrule Castle after completing mask sales.

evidence.quote: Now head to Hyrule castle and get the mask of truth.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Bombing the lone tree across the river to the left outside Hyrule Castle reveals a grotto with a Gold Skulltula on a cobweb.

evidence.quote:
cross the river and you'll see a lone tree, bomb 
the tree and a hole will open with [GS035] on a cobweb in the corner.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is found at night on one of the window shutters of Malon's house.

evidence.quote:
enter at night time.  On one of  
the window shudders on Malon's house you'll see [GS036].

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is located on the wall to the right of the pillar in Lon Lon Ranch.

evidence.quote:
Run to the right  
of the pillar where you previously got the piece of heart and you'll find  
[GS037] on the wall.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Bombing the center of a circle of rocks in the red soil on the way to Gerudo Valley opens a hole containing a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
On the way up you'll see a circle of rocks in the red soil area.   
Bomb in the middle of the circle and you'll find a hole with [GS038].

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula can be seen near the waterfall at night in Gerudo Valley.

evidence.quote:
At night time if you look to  
the waterfall you'll see [GS039].

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Gliding across the river with a Cucco to a lone platform and breaking the crate yields a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: To the left you'll see a lone crate out on it's own platform (yeah remember the thing to practice in Zora's River). Glide to the crate, set the cucco down and break the crate. Now pick it up again and get [PoH18].

subject: Piece of Heart
text: A Piece of Heart sits in an opening behind the waterfall reached by climbing a ladder from the river.

evidence.quote:
Under the waterfall, you'll see a ladder leading up 
to a hold in the rock wall with [PoH19] in it.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Dropping bugs into the small patch of soil near the Gerudo and cow reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Go to the Gerudo and the  
cow and you'll see a small patch of soil, Use your bug...and  
collect [GS040], and plant a magic bean.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is located on the outer wall of the Lakeside Laboratory at night and can be grabbed with the boomerang from the bridge.

evidence.quote:
If it's night time on the side of the lakeside Laboratory  
you'll see [GS041] (stand on the bridge and throw the boomerang at it).

subject: Business Scrub
text: Bombing inside the square fenced area opens a grotto where a Business Scrub sells a Piece of Heart for 10 rupees.

evidence.quote:
Jump into the middle of the fences and  
set a bomb down and it'll blow a hole in the ground.  Inside you'll find a  
business scrub who, for 10 rupees, sells you [PoH20].

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Behind a bombable wall through the crawl hole in the room with the Gohma Larvae lies a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
climb up the block and go through the crawl hole on the far wall, in that  
room is the bombable wall with [GS042].

subject: Magic Bean
text: A magic bean can be planted in the soft soil patch located next to the shop.

evidence.quote:
leave the Deku tree and plant  
a magic bean in the soil next to the shop.

subject: Magic Bean
text: Taking the first two lefts in the Lost Woods leads to a soft soil patch where a magic bean can be planted.

evidence.quote:
Go into the lost woods and take 
the first two lefts and plant a magic bean.

subject: Lost Woods
text: From the Lost Woods entrance, going right, left, right, left, left reaches the Forest Stage screen.

evidence.quote:
Backtrack to the first screen  
and go right then left then right then left then left and you'll be on the  
screen with the forest stage.

subject: Deku Nut Upgrade
text: Showing the Mask of Truth to the Deku Scrubs at the Forest Stage awards the first Deku Nut upgrade.

evidence.quote:
Plant the beans in the soil and jump into  
the hole and show off your Mask of Truth to get the first Deku nut upgrade.

subject: Deku Nut Upgrade
text: The Forest Stage Deku Nut upgrade becomes permanently lost if Link transforms into an adult before obtaining it.

evidence.quote:
!!!!!Don't go to the Temple of Time and become an adult until you've shown  
!!!!!the mask of truth on the forest stage or the Deku nut upgrade will be  
!!!!!permantly lost

subject: Business Scrub
text: Bombing the rock at the entrance of Sacred Forest Meadow uncovers a hole where a Business Scrub sells the second Deku Nut upgrade.

evidence.quote:
entrance to the sacred forest meadow, bomb the rock and jump  
into the exposed hole.  There's two business scrubs, one sells the second  
Deku nut upgrade.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: In the boulder maze on the top floor of Goron City, following right, left, left, right leads to a crate holding a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
far left room which is a rock maze...*chough*right,left,left,right*cough*.  You'll see a gossip stones and a  
crate in the corner containing [GS043].

subject: Hot Rodder Goron
text: Stopping the giant rolling Goron with a bomb and speaking with him awards the biggest bomb bag.

evidence.quote:
see the huge  
rolling goron below, blow him up and talk to him and he'll give you the  
biggest bomb bag

subject: Dampé's Heart-Pounding Gravedigging Tour
text: Entering Kakariko Graveyard between 6 and 9 PM right after the wolf howls allows playing Dampe's tour to dig up a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
enter right after the wolf  
howls (the grave digging tour is only from 6-9 that would make it 6pm).    
Assuming you've followed my instructions so far you should have over 400  
rupees still to waste trying to find [PoH21].

subject: Dying Soldier
text: A dying soldier can be visited in the back alley of Hyrule Market before becoming an adult.

evidence.quote:
Now's your chance to do all of  
that fun stuff to see if it's on your game namely the dying soldier in the  
alley in the market.

subject: Ingo's Horse Rental
text: Ingo charges 10 rupees to ride horses in the corral, which can be recouped by jumping both fences for 5 rupees each.

evidence.quote:
he'll charge 
you 10 rupees to ride the horses, you can get the money back by jumping  
each of the two fences (five rupees each).

subject: Epona
text: Playing Epona's Song summons Epona in the horse pen, who is the only horse capable of winning the race against Ingo.

evidence.quote:
Remember to play Eponia's song  
to get Eponia to come to you.  You can't win the race with Ingo with any  
other horse.

subject: Ingo
text: Challenging Ingo to a horse race while riding Epona requires having at least 50 rupees.

evidence.quote:
talk to Ingo while on Eponia he'll ask you to race him  
for 50 rupees (note that he only charges you if you lose but you have to  
have 50 rupees before he'll race you.

subject: Ingo Horse Race
text: To beat Ingo, cut inside on turns using carrots, block him from passing, use one carrot every six seconds during regeneration, and spend all carrots on the final stretch.

evidence.quote:
He makes wide turns so as you come to a turn stat using carrots and make  
the turn tighter than he does thus passing him.  Once you're in front of 
him just stay directly in front of him so he can't pass you and use the 
carrots as they regenerate...so every six seconds use one carrot and you'll gain 2 
and use 1.  When you get to the last stretch, use them all for the win.

subject: Epona
text: Winning the second horse race against Ingo and leaping over any ranch perimeter wall escapes Lon Lon Ranch with Epona.

evidence.quote:
After winning the second race Ingo 
will lock you in...simply jump any of the walls of the ranch and you have 
your self a horse

subject: Broken Bridge
text: Riding Epona allows Link to jump across the broken bridge in Gerudo Valley to reach the other side.

evidence.quote:
jump the broken bridge on Eponia.  Hop off and head in on 
foot.

subject: House of Skulltula
text: With 42 Gold Skulltulas, Link can get some bombchus from the House of Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
With 42 Gold Skullita’s you  
can go get some bombchu's from the house of Skullita
